measurement: neutral-pose model Y bounding-box height; uniform scale only, preserve natural wing span
wingFlapAxis: local Z (Blender bone local Y is vertical)
notes: Small birds and insects are below half hero height; boars and badgers are above. Legendary species use explicit 2.65-4.40 world-unit heights. Do not normalize wing span independently. maxSpan is a ceiling on horizontal span and takes precedence over target height for thin manta, serpent, and long-wing silhouettes.
scaleRule: min(desiredWorldHeight / neutralBBoxHeight, maxSpan / max(neutralBBoxWidth, neutralBBoxDepth)); one uniform scale for all axes

familyNotes.chest-spirit: Grounded chest form. Use standard stage heights 1.275 / 1.6575 / 2.15475 with uniform scaling; retain maxSpan ceilings and include the tongue in bounds.
familyNotes.book-spirit: Grounded book form. Standard stage heights 1.275 / 1.6575 / 2.15475, uniform scale with existing maxSpan ceilings; no hands or feet.
